protected-path-conflict.label: needs-session
protected-path-conflict.why: a conflicted path is a workflow, submodule config or a settings file, which the lane does not resolve

workflow-staged.why: the merge stages the pull request's own .github/workflows/ changes together with the base's, which the lane token cannot push, so a session merges main by hand

unexpected-path-staged.why: the conflict resolution changes a path outside the conflicted ones, which the lane does not push

repeat-cap.why: the lane has resolved conflicts on this branch as many times in a row as its cap allows

unresolved-conflict.why: the lane could not resolve every conflict

conflict-patch-invalid.why: the conflict resolution the lane wrote did not pass validation, so the merge was not pushed

conflict-patch-not-applied.why: the conflict resolution did not apply to the merge it was written for, so the merge was not pushed

conflict-patch-protected-path.label: needs-session
conflict-patch-protected-path.why: the conflict resolution changes a path the lane does not push: .github/workflows/, CODEOWNERS, .gitmodules or a settings file

shared-copy-tooling-changed.label: needs-session
shared-copy-tooling-changed.why: the pull request changes scripts/sync-shared-copies.sh, scripts/shared-copies.txt or scripts/lib, so the lane does not regenerate its shared-library copies with the base's tooling

shared-copy-path-unregistered.label: needs-session
shared-copy-path-unregistered.why: regenerating the shared-library copies wrote a path the base scripts/shared-copies.txt lists as no copy, so the lane pushed nothing

shared-copy-workflow-staged.why: the merge stages the pull request's own .github/workflows/ changes together with the base's, which the lane token cannot push, so a session merges main by hand

shared-copy-unexpected-path-staged.label: needs-session
shared-copy-unexpected-path-staged.why: the regenerated copies change a path the base scripts/shared-copies.txt does not list as a copy, which the lane does not push

shared-copy-patch-invalid.why: the regenerated copies did not pass validation, so the merge was not pushed

shared-copy-patch-not-applied.why: the regenerated copies did not apply to the merge they were made on, so the merge was not pushed

shared-copy-patch-protected-path.label: needs-session
shared-copy-patch-protected-path.why: the regenerated copies change a path the lane does not push: .github/workflows/, CODEOWNERS, .gitmodules or a settings file

feedback-protected-path.label: needs-session
feedback-protected-path.why: the pull request changes .github/workflows/, which the lane token cannot push, so the lane does not address its review threads

feedback-round-cap.why: the lane has addressed review threads on this pull request as many rounds as its cap allows, and an open thread is a security finding rated CRITICAL or unrated, an intent finding, or a person holds the pull request, so a person decides

feedback-not-converging.why: review rounds are not converging: after the round cap and one fresh fixer round the code review still has open findings, so the fixer and the reviewer disagree on what the change should be

feedback-uncertain.why: the lane could not settle a CRITICAL finding, a security-review finding with no rating the lane reads, or a thread a person opened, which no adjudicator judges, so a person decides it

feedback-verifier-open.why: the lane left a pr-verify note open (uncertain, deferred or answered incorrect, or still open after the round cap and one fresh fixer round); pr-verify judges the next head afresh

feedback-not-landed.why: a fix the lane recorded did not reach the branch, so none of its review replies was posted

feedback-invalid.why: the review replies the lane recorded did not pass validation, so none was posted

feedback-partial.why: posting the review replies stopped partway, or a fixed thread could not be resolved

feedback-untaken-threads.why: the pull request has an unresolved review thread the lane does not take (a reviewer it does not act on, a review of an older head, or a thread it already answered), so nothing will resolve it

feedback-publish-failed.why: the reply job failed before it decided anything (a lane token it could not get, or a script error), so no reply was posted

feedback-incomplete.why: the lane did not record a disposition for every review thread it kept, so none was posted

feedback-disputed.why: a disputed review finding is one only a person decides (a CRITICAL finding, a security-review finding with no rating the lane reads, or a thread a person opened or directed)

feedback-stood-open.why: an adjudicator found a review finding stands, and the next round left it open again

feedback-unadjudicated.why: the lane left a review finding open and no adjudicator verdict settled it: none was recorded, it found the finding does not hold where the lane had not disputed it (an UNCERTAIN or VALID-defer reply), which only an INCORRECT reply lets a verdict resolve, it found the finding asks only for tests whose covering check runs had not all passed when the round began, or it raised a security question on a finding the security-review lane rated below CRITICAL

feedback-question-intent.why: an adjudicator found that a disputed review finding turns on what the change is meant to do, which a person decides

feedback-question-design.why: an adjudicator found that a disputed review finding turns on a design choice, which a person decides

feedback-question-security.why: an adjudicator found that a disputed review finding, other than a security-review finding rated below CRITICAL, turns on a security judgment, which a person decides

dependency-round-cap.label: needs-session
dependency-round-cap.why: the lane has reviewed this dependency update as many rounds as its cap allows

dependency-invalid.why: the dependency review verdict did not pass validation, so the lane acted on none of it

dependency-fix-not-landed.label: needs-session
dependency-fix-not-landed.why: the dependency review chose a fix, but no fix commit reached the branch (the lane lands a fix only when it changes nothing but the versions in npm or pip manifest and lock files outside .github/)

dependency-security-close.why: the dependency review would close a security update, which the lane never closes

dependency-escalate.why: the dependency review found a risk the lane does not decide alone

dependency-config-unreadable.label: needs-session
dependency-config-unreadable.why: the lane could not read the base .github/dependabot.yml, so it does not mark this dependency update for merge

dependency-files-truncated.label: needs-session
dependency-files-truncated.why: the dependency review chose merge, but the files listing it read was cut short, so the lane does not mark this dependency update for merge

dependency-fix-refused.why: a commit on the dependency update other than Dependabot's changes more than a version of an npm or pip manifest or lock file, as a regular file outside .github/, so the lane does not act on the review

dependency-control-uncited.label: needs-session
dependency-control-uncited.why: the dependency review chose merge for a review-only dependency without quoting its control, so the lane does not mark it for merge

dependency-workflow-unpinned.label: needs-session
dependency-workflow-unpinned.why: the dependency review chose merge, but the update changes a workflow or action file by more than swapping one full-SHA action pin for another, so the lane does not mark it for merge

ci-fix-round-cap.why: the lane has pushed as many CI fixes to this pull request as its cap allows, and CI still fails

ci-fix-empty.why: the lane changed nothing that fixes the failing checks

ci-fix-invalid.why: the CI fix the lane wrote did not pass validation, so it was not pushed

ci-fix-protected-path.label: needs-session
ci-fix-protected-path.why: the CI fix changes a path the lane does not push: .github/workflows/, CODEOWNERS, .gitmodules or a settings file

ci-fix-weaken-retry.why: the lane could fix a failing check only by weakening a test, which is refused, so it runs one fresh fixer round on this head that must keep the test's assertions

ci-fix-weaken-required.label: needs-session
ci-fix-weaken-required.why: the lane could fix a failing check only by weakening a required check, and the head has no fresh fixer round left (it ran one, or an earlier lane stop already spent its same-head retry), so a session builder takes it

ci-fix-not-applied.why: the CI fix did not apply to the head it was written for, so it was not pushed

ci-fix-escalated.label: needs-session
ci-fix-escalated.why: the lane could not fix every failing check, after one retry a model rung up, so a session builder takes it; its run log names each one and why
